name: DigitalOcean Spaces
description: Persona, skill, and native S3-compatible tools that let an agent read and write files in DigitalOcean Spaces object storage — list buckets and objects, upload (put) content or local files, download (get) objects to a file or as text, and delete objects. Requests are signed with AWS Signature V4 using the configured DO_SPACES_KEY / DO_SPACES_SECRET for the DO_SPACES_REGION (default nyc3).
